tish.name: TISH
tish.look: Adult compact green goblin with chestnut spiky forelock, warm amber eyes, coral scarf, patched dark brown leather tunic and shorts, boots, small cross-body satchel. Same charming face as reference, no younger child redesign.

tish.emotions: CALM, JOY, WORRY, DETERMINED, SHEEPISH, RELIEF

luma.name: JO

bum.name: BOOM

FRONT stone on viewer left; BACK stone on viewer right. Do not mirror.
bum.detail: Stone palm and stone forearm transition to GREEN upper arm in separate labelled ANATOMICAL RIGHT ARM close-up; backpack. All ears smooth intact. No combat or clenched threatening fist.
bum.emotions: CALM, JOY, WORRY, RESOLVE, SHY, RELIEF
